scope_note: A clause can have legitimate business purposes. Risk depends on wording, context, negotiation, and jurisdiction; this taxonomy is not legal advice.

categories.label: Automatic renewal
categories.description: Renews an agreement unless a party acts within a stated window.
categories.why_it_matters: May create an unexpected continuing obligation.
categories.limitations: requirements vary by jurisdiction and product

categories.label: Price escalation
categories.description: Allows price or fees to increase under a trigger or discretion.
categories.limitations: meaning depends on defined terms and applicable law

categories.label: Unilateral modification
categories.description: Allows one party to change terms, policies, or prices.
questions: Is notice required? Can the customer cancel?

categories.label: Termination or cancellation
categories.description: Sets conditions, notice, or charges for ending an agreement.
categories.why_it_matters: Can affect exit cost and timing.

categories.label: Auto-billing authorization
categories.description: Authorizes automatic payment or recurring charges.
categories.why_it_matters: May continue charges unless canceled correctly.

categories.label: Limitation of liability
categories.description: Limits the kinds or amount of damages a party may seek.
categories.why_it_matters: Changes remedies if something goes wrong.
